display_title: If You Wish It Badly Enough, the Universe Will Grant It
description:
One day, Him-Chan wakes up to find herself with a supernatural power that destroys everything she touches. Unable to find the cause or find a solution, days pass by, until she destroys everything around her with her uncontrollable power, eventually injuring a guy she's interested in. Feeling a sense of shame, she flees to transfer schools and vows to live quietly in her new home.

 *"This time, I'm really going to live quietly!"*

While watching YouTube, Him-Chan learns about ghosts and shamans. With a determination to win, she visits a nearby shaman known for her strength.

 *"You can suppress your power by making physical contact, just like now."*

She's found the solution he's been waiting for, but what a shocking revelation! To control your power, you need physical contact?! Will Him-Chan, who simply wants to live quietly like air, ever be able to achieve his school life?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
